candidateSource: immutable G1 commit plus explicit G2 product manifest; never live mutable implicit HEAD
portRule: Root preflights each host and records actual binding; occupied ports trigger new explicit plan delta, no process eviction

postgres.schemaMigrationOwner: Root-only existing Native MikroORM migration runner; original92 plus declared R4 additions
postgres.secrets: fresh generated task-specific, private file only; never old private, inline tool output, committed files, or public raw row strings
postgres.fixtureBoundary: fresh synthetic actor/org/role IDs <=64-character codes, explicit ownership registration and immutable seed/catalog/ACL fingerprints; no assumed remembered IDs
postgres.preserve: PG17 and all old environments/private/volumes untouched; new volume retained after normal stop

authors.worktreeRule: Root uses create_worktree after independent G1 Pass and actual online freeze, detached at exact G1 commit; Root exclusively Git, authors source-only; no product edits before admission

publicCachePolicy: Only public dependencies/browser/container images after exact version/hash readback may be reused read-only. New isolated target/profile/output. No whole old private, browser profile or 34GB target copy. Source base pinned separately from runtime evidence.

actualAcceptance.contractProducer: real project/cost/bid -> B draft -> A01 -> R3 pricing release -> A05/A04/A08 -> B submit/R2 review/activate -> A09
actualAcceptance.financeProducer: C facts against those real active contracts; prepared actual-cost mappings only for negative guards, not claimed real cost producer
actualAcceptance.ui: Linux and Windows browsers against Rust for new contract/readiness/approval flow; corresponding Native baseline captures are historical reference, not new-contract conformance; no invented finance UI
actualAcceptance.faults: registered mandatory business/snapshot/binding/plan/audit/session edges, precommit trigger/permission faults with proven hit and full rollback; keep failed and corrected attempts
actualAcceptance.races: controlled lock/barrier ordering and independent PG sessions, source replacement/current uniqueness/expectedVersion/payment remaining/initialization identity
actualAcceptance.privacy: private full sensitive graph; public explicit safe typed projections and per-table digests, never credentials hidden inside serialized row strings
actualAcceptance.cleanup: owned-only IDs, before-absence plus successful create/outerACK plus live PG proof; two no-op cleanup reads, full seed/catalog/ACL/object restoration, exact process identity graceful stop and bound-port release
